# EduWise Solutions

> EduWise Solutions is an Indian ed-tech company offering industry-aligned, live mentor-led career programs in software development, AI & data, cloud, DevOps and security, engineering and design, and business and finance. Programs include hands-on projects, placement assistance and certification, plus AWS certification training.
